lateral_flank_blob_constellation.centroid_triangulation: A series of roughly circular high-luminance pixel clusters arranged in staggered vertical columns posterior to the fifth gill slit, exhibiting a reduction in centroid diameter along the posterior-ventral trajectory.

carinae_gradient_vectors.ridge_trajectory: Three parallel longitudinal ridges situated on the upper lateral flank, characterized by a high-intensity pixel edge on the dorsal aspect and a distinct shadow gradient on the ventral aspect.

dorsal_fin_surface_patterning.internal_spot_density: Sparse distribution of approximately 12-15 low-contrast circular markers concentrated within the posterior half of the first dorsal fin silhouette.

other_distinctive_markers: Dense cluster of high-contrast, small-diameter circular spots localized on the proximal dorsal surface of the primary pectoral fin.
